fact: Benin's playbook, with figures as at 6 May 2026, states that the country self-financed the initial RAVIP census and the setting-up of the RNPP, that fees from identity cards, certificates and civil-status acts go into ANIP's resources, that the World Bank's WURI project and UNICEF also contributed, and that the agency's economic model is still being drawn up for presentation in 2027; it names the Ministry of the Interior's Direction de l'état civil as responsible for national civil-status policy and cites no current strategy or costed plan.
title: Construire la confiance, l'inclusion et l'interopérabilité. Playbook Benin
